# Data and implementation provenance

Terrain/material derive from the owner's NASA CGI Moon Kit uploads
`ldem_16_uint.tif` and `lroc_color_16bit_srgb_4k.tif`, with original UInt16 sample
values preserved by the compression codec. NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit:
https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4720/ . Credit NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center
Scientific Visualization Studio, LRO/LOLA and LROC source products as applicable.
No NASA endorsement is asserted. Appearance-adjusted colour is not a calibrated
reflectance/spectral product. No font files are included.

The V5 surface formula and original fixed profile are preserved. The kernel is
original programme code supplied as C and WebAssembly, not a third-party game
engine. This contribution inherits the repository's code licensing on adoption;
no exclusive rights to NASA data or the underlying scientific formulae are claimed.
The exact source/asset hashes and their locally verified lineage are in the
integration package. Compiler reproduction is optional; no foreign executable
installer, npm bootstrap or runtime download is needed to apply this patch.
